get.description: The process is up. Checks nothing else.
The process can serve requests: the database is reachable and a rule set is active.

What the driver may choose and the defaults, from the active rule set, plus the
attribution of the chosen providers.

post.description: Plan a trip: up to 3 routes with checkpoints, weather, risk and a recommendation.
The heatmap grid around the given route lines for the whole forecast window.

get.description: Place suggestions for a typed query; `session` (a UUID) groups one typing session.
The coordinates of a picked suggestion.

HealthStatus.description: The only answer a live process gives.
HealthStatus.title: HealthStatus

ReadinessOut.description: Whether the process can serve requests, and the outcome of each check.
ReadinessOut.title: ReadinessOut

AttributionOut.description: A notice the map shows where a provider's data is displayed; `url` links it if set.
AttributionOut.title: AttributionOut

BooleanOptionOut.description: An on/off option. When `available` is false, only `default` is accepted.
BooleanOptionOut.title: BooleanOptionOut

DepartureWindowOut.description: The departures a trip accepts, relative to now.
DepartureWindowOut.title: DepartureWindowOut

HeatmapLayerOut.description: A heatmap layer; `variable` is null for the combined risk.
HeatmapLayerOut.title: HeatmapLayerOut

HeatmapLayersOut.description: The heatmap layers and the one shown first.
HeatmapLayersOut.title: HeatmapLayersOut

NumberOptionOut.description: A number in `unit`, with inclusive bounds. `default` is null when `required`.
NumberOptionOut.title: NumberOptionOut

OptionTier.description: Where the form shows an option: in the main form, or under "Advanced options".
OptionTier.title: OptionTier

OptionsOut.description: What the driver may choose, and the tables the frontend renders by iterating.
OptionsOut.title: OptionsOut

RiskLevelOut.description: One row of the risk level table.
RiskLevelOut.title: RiskLevelOut

SpacingOut.description: A checkpoint spacing as staff entered it, and in km.
SpacingOut.title: SpacingOut

StretchMethod.description: How a stretch between two samples gets its level (`docs/risk-model.md`).
StretchMethod.title: StretchMethod

TripOptionName.description: Every trip parameter; also the request field that carries it.
TripOptionName.title: TripOptionName

Unit.description: Every unit a value may be entered or returned in.
Unit.title: Unit

WeatherVariable.description: Conditions a rule set can rate.
WeatherVariable.title: WeatherVariable

WeatherVariableOut.description: One row of the weather condition table.
WeatherVariableOut.title: WeatherVariableOut

ErrorBodyOut.description: A catalog error: its code, a message for the driver, and field details if any.
ErrorBodyOut.title: ErrorBodyOut

ErrorCode.description: Every error code the API can return.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

ErrorDetailOut.description: One field-level problem. `field` is a dotted path to the request field.
ErrorDetailOut.title: ErrorDetailOut

ErrorOut.description: The body of every error response.
ErrorOut.title: ErrorOut

CheckpointOut.description:
A checkpoint. `level` is null when Unknown or on a ferry; `weather_level` is the level
from the forecast even on a ferry.
CheckpointOut.title: CheckpointOut

ConditionOut.description: One condition at a checkpoint: its value and level (band level raised by load rules).
ConditionOut.title: ConditionOut

NotRecommendableReason.description: Why one route cannot be recommended, in the order they are checked.
NotRecommendableReason.title: NotRecommendableReason

RankingKeyOut.description: A route's rounded ranking key, one value per entry of `key_names`.
RankingKeyOut.title: RankingKeyOut

RouteOut.description:
One route, in ranking order; `rank` 1 is the best. `source` says how it was found and
is also its label's text key.
RouteOut.title: RouteOut

RouteSource.description: How a kept route was found; the route card shows its label.
RouteSource.title: RouteSource

RouteSummaryOut.description: Distances, risk and time of one route.
RouteSummaryOut.title: RouteSummaryOut

RouteWarning.description: Warnings a route summary can carry.
RouteWarning.title: RouteWarning

StopKind.description: A rest stop the clock inserts.
StopKind.title: StopKind

StopOut.description: A rest stop the clock inserted.
StopOut.title: StopOut

StretchKind.description:
Where a stretch's level comes from. Its properties are in
`planning.domain.summary.STRETCH_KINDS`.
StretchKind.title: StretchKind

StretchOut.description:
A part of the route with one level; `polyline` is its line (Google encoded, precision 5).
`level` is null for Unknown and for a ferry that is not rated.
StretchOut.title: StretchOut

TripOut.description:
A planned trip. Exactly one of `recommended_route_id` and `no_recommendation_reason` is
set.
TripOut.title: TripOut

TripWarning.description: Warnings about the whole trip, shown above the route cards.
TripWarning.title: TripWarning

TruckPositionOut.description:
Where the truck is `hour` whole hours after departure; it stays at the destination after
arrival.
TruckPositionOut.title: TruckPositionOut

TripEndIn.description: A place the driver picked: its label and position.
TripEndIn.title: TripEndIn

TripIn.description: A trip to plan. Omitted options take their defaults from `GET /api/v1/options`.
TripIn.title: TripIn

GridLayerOut.description:
One heatmap layer. `levels[cell][hour]` indexes the response's `levels` (null: no
forecast). `values[cell][hour]` is the metric value; null for the combined layer.
GridLayerOut.title: GridLayerOut

WeatherGridOut.description: Every corridor cell for every hour from departure to departure plus the window.
WeatherGridOut.title: WeatherGridOut

WeatherGridIn.description:
The route lines the client holds (the `polyline` of each route), the departure and the
load.
WeatherGridIn.title: WeatherGridIn

PlaceSuggestionOut.description: One suggestion; picking it costs one details call.
PlaceSuggestionOut.title: PlaceSuggestionOut

PlaceOut.description: A picked place: the label to show and send back with the trip, and its position.
PlaceOut.title: PlaceOut
